title: A most entertaining and informative Segway tour
text:
Carlos and  his colleague were an amazing duo who led a very informative and entertaining Segway tour. They spent a bit of time training and building confidence in those who had never been on a Segway before. It was a most enjoyable couple of hours. 
Thanks guys.
author: gairney

title: Super
text: Carlos was profesional.. all trip was perfect

title: Shout out Carlos!
text: Excellent experience, we had the tour to ourselves, saw loads of Barcelona in just the 2 hours experience and segways were great. Shout-out to Carlos our hilarious guide! You will have a great time with him
author: U2608YTalexanders

title: Barcelona

author: X161TRdaniels

title: The best Segway and the Best of Barcelona
text: I've been to  Barcelona several times before and love the city.  This was a top experience.  I saw things in Barcelona I had never seen before.  I learned about the city and had a blast.  Our guide, Carlos, was so personable and friendly.  He is easy to get along with...gabe us a Segway refresher and then took us to see amazing places. Some of the spots were places you can have FUN on a Segway.  Many had historical info attached but Carlos made it all fun....and he was so patient with us when we wanted to stop and take photos
author: SSCL Business  D

title: Jump on a Segway tour you will be glad you did
text: We decided last minute to book a Segway tour with the family. So worth the money and the time. Great way to see so much of the city and have a blast doing it. Mitchell was great, made our day totally enjoyable.
author: Jim V

title: Just perfect!
text: We had an absolutely amazing tour with Ronny. He’s such a nice guy—he took us to the Botanical Garden, Montjuïc, and the Olympic Port. He took great care of us and had lots of interesting stories to share that we hadn’t heard before. We’d love to go with you again anytime, Ronny! Thank you so much!
author: Camper45641541232

title: Great experience in Barcelona!!
text: This was a great experience. Natasha was awesome. She really knows the history of Barcelona and gave us great instructions for the segways. . . It was a little shaky at first, but we caught on. . . I highly recommend!
author: Tracy B

title: RobotCity
text: It was a very great amazing tour by the tour leader, great explanation and cool adventures and places to go to. Also very affordable

title: Fantastic walk!
text: We did a 1 hour segway tour (like hoverboard) with the guide Pau, who speaks Portuguese, and we love it! Very friendly, showed many interesting points. It's worth it!
